summary.text: Brent Hagenbuch is a Republican member of the Texas Senate representing District 30, serving since 2025. He is chairman and owner of Titus Transport and is from Denton.

paragraphs.text: Hagenbuch also owns Giddy Up Transport, a freight logistics firm, and previously worked in strategy and general management at McKinsey & Company and PepsiCo's Frito-Lay division and as CEO of CompX.

He earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the U.S. Naval Academy, a master's in civil engineering from Stanford and an MBA from UCLA, and served as an officer in the U.S. Navy Civil Engineer Corps.
His community service includes serving as a board director of Feed the Children and as a former Little Elm Planning & Zoning commissioner.
He is married to Jean and they have two children and three grandchildren.
